# Chalmers four-beam series, specimen PRC: four-point bending to failure
#
# Fernandez, I., Ekstrom, D., Rempling, R., Gil Berrocal, C. (2025)
#   "Evaluation of post-tensioned reinforced and fiber reinforced concrete
#    beams by using DOFS", Structural Concrete 26:6274-6293,
#   doi 10.1002/suco.70224 (open access, CC-BY)
# Dataset: researchdata.se 2025-114, file Data_loading.json, table MTS.
#   Thinned from 2152 rows to 201 by equal steps in deflection; the peak row
#   and the last row are kept.
#
# POST-TENSIONED reinforced concrete, same mix and cubes as RC.
#   T-section 320 x 130 flange, 150 x 515 web, 645 total.
#   4D16 top, 3D16 bottom at 38 mm, 3D8 around the duct, D8 s200.
#   Flat plastic duct 71 x 21 internal with 4 x D15.7 strands, Y1860S7
#   (f_pk 1860 MPa), CCL XF20/5/13 anchorage, GROUTED after tensioning.
#   Profile: straight 250 mm from each end at the section centroid
#   (370 mm above the soffit), parabolic over 3000 mm, then straight
#   1000 mm to midspan resting on the bottom bars; mirrored.
#   Jacked to 490 kN total (4 tendons, individually, at 7 days).
#   Measured: slope change near 70 kN/jack (cracking), yield near
#   200 kN/jack, peak 256 kN/jack, failure by compression crushing.
#
# TEST SETUP (paper, section 2.3)
#   Beam 8500 mm long, rollers 250 mm from each end -> clear span 8000 mm.
#   Two actuators 3000 mm from each roller: shear spans 3000, constant moment
#   region 2000 mm. One jack under displacement control at 3 mm/min, the other
#   force-following. Tested at 160 days, after the long-term stage.
#
# CONSISTENT WITH THE DATA ITSELF, checked before the paper was read:
#   Ra + Rb = F1 + F2 to 1e-3 (simply supported, nothing else applied), and
#   M1/Ra = M2/Rb = 3.0000 m in every row of every beam -- the shear span.
#
# LOADS ARE PER JACK IN THE PAPER'S FIGURES. Column 1 here is the SUM, so
# halve it to compare with Figure 14: the paper's "around 150 kN" yield for
# the reference beams and "up to 250 kN" for the post-tensioned ones are
# 300 and 500 kN in this column.
#
# columns: F1+F2 (kN), mean of the two load-point deflections (mm),
#          Disp1 (mm), Disp2 (mm), Ra (kN), Rb (kN)
